text:
Morgan: quick async from twilight shift — short TL;DR on SLO/alerts, a couple CR pings, and one oncall follow-up.
Morgan: did: ran the EU batcher canary, validated latency medians back to baseline after the kernel tweak. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/latency/eu-batcher
Morgan: did: filed PR #4821 to tweak autoscaler thresholds (small mem headroom bump). pinging @Lee for reviews.
Morgan: blocked: seeing ~0.3% 5xx for embed endpoints during big prefix loads, unclear if it's batching overflow or upstream token limit.
Lee: digging into the 5xx — I saw similar traces around 01:12 UTC, attaching quick trace id in case useful: trace: 0x7f9b2c.
Lee: short query I ran: `sum(rate(api.errors{endpoint="embed"}[5m])) by (code)` — shows spike aligns with large seq requests.
Jamie: oncall note: I restarted node eu-batcher-03 to clear a stuck KV cache, that temporarily reduced error rate. Worth keeping an eye.
Priya: looking at the model-side logs, we had a queued request backlog hitting the request queue cap, maybe the autoscaler bump helps. Also adding a guard to reject >32k token requests in private deployment paths.
Sam: oncall handoff: I took ownership at 02:00 UTC, will stay until 09:00 UTC. If errors resurface and we see >0.5% 5xx sustained, escalate to paging.
Morgan: cr ping @Lee — PR #4821 (autoscaler bump). small change, tests pass but would appreciate a quick review before I cut a canary.
Lee: ack, will take a look in next 30. If I need infra context, @Priya can you paste the short sequence-length histogram?
Priya: paste: ```
seq_len_hist: {"<64": 62.1, "64-512": 30.4, "512-2048": 6.8, ">2048": 0.7}
```
Priya: note the >2048 bin doubled during the spike window.
Jamie: ops question — should we enable the temporary reject rule for >32k tokens for Hosted? That will drop very large noisy requests.
Sam: yes for Hosted canary, but add a clear metric and 429 path so clients get actionable error.
Morgan: +1. I'll add the reject rule behind a runtime flag and a metric `requests.rejected.too_long` and roll to canary.
Morgan: quick ask: does anyone have a spare minute to approve my small dashboard tweak? It adds a per-model 99th percentile panel for embed latency. PR #4830.
Lee: can do in 15.
Priya: note for next steps: add an alert that triggers on increasing fraction of >2048 seqs to SRE channel so we can catch workload changes sooner.
Jamie: filed ticket SRE-651 to track the alert and runbook change. I put the initial runbook steps in the ticket description.
incident-bot: Incident check: no active incidents. Latest incident (INC-2026-11) closed 12h ago.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: eu-batcher autoscaler bump -> canary group 5%. Will run at 03:15 UTC unless stopped.
Sam: I'll watch the canary roll. If error rate creeps up, I'll pause.
Morgan: thanks all. Today: roll the canary, add the reject rule behind flag, follow up on dashboard PRs, and monitor the `requests.rejected.too_long` metric.
Lee: followup later today — will share quick trace summary and review #4821 and #4830.
Priya: will draft the alert rule and add it to SRE-651.
Jamie: thumbs up. anything else?
Morgan: nope, that's it. :thumbsup:
